title: Shopify Overtook eBay In Total Sales
source: Shopify quarterly and annual shareholder letters and SEC Form 6-K filings; eBay Inc. quarterly and annual earnings releases and SEC Form 10-K filings, as compiled by Marketplace Pulse and Business Quant. Gross merchandise volume ($ billions) - Shopify: 7.7 (2015), 26.3 (2017), 61.1 (2019), 119.6 (2020), 175.4 (2021), 197.2 (2022). eBay: ~82 (2015), ~88 (2017), ~90.2 (2019), ~100.1 (2020, pandemic-boosted), ~87.4 (2021), ~73.4 (2022). Shopify's annual GMV overtook eBay's for the first time in 2020.
